Of all the tickets printed for "EASY MONEY", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is well into its run, with three of eight top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Every line of EASY MONEY's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5057.headline: How much has sold

5059.body:
"THE CASH WHEEL" is past the halfway point of its run, with about a third of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Everything above about "THE CASH WHEEL" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
5059.headline: Tickets sold so far

5060.body:
The most common win left on "FIND THE 7S" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $500, and 47 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If "FIND THE 7S" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
5060.headline: Prize table details

5063.body:
"CA$H IN HAND" has two of four top prizes left and is about halfway through its run. About a third of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed faster than the tickets are selling, which is a reason to be careful.
